policy: Force both BF16 and FP8 M. BF16 M is set in an isolated copy of the generated profile, FP8 M via compiler flag. Other defaults unchanged: stages3 and slice mask3 for both dtypes. Normal M-dependent launch/occupancy policy remains active.
method: Each seed:100 calls per CUDA graph,9 sweeps,discard first,max-rank CUDA events then median. Table is arithmetic mean of medians for seeds1700 and1300. M order reversed for second seed. Weight preparation excluded; online source quantization included.
numerical_policy: BF16 global diff<5e-3; only the prior bounded Qwen35B one-token exception allowed in full DT suite
